notes: Erebor -- the Columbus, OH digital bank founded by Palmer Luckey to serve AI, defense, advanced-manufacturing and crypto clients (positioned as an SVB successor) -- was reported 2026-08-10 to be in late-stage talks to raise ~$1.5B at an $8B pre-money valuation (nearly doubling the $4.35B mark from a $350M round in Dec 2025); deposits reportedly quadrupled to ~$4.6B by end of July. Multiple outlets (Axios, Benzinga, TechStartups, Retail Banker International, cryptobriefing, MLQ) name Palmer Luckey, Peter Thiel and Joe Lonsdale together as the bank's founders/backers -- a notable thiel_extended + paypal_mafia network cluster (Luckey, Thiel, Lonsdale all tracked network members) -- with Founders Fund, 8VC (Lonsdale's firm), a16z, Lux Capital and Haun Ventures named as likely round participants. FILED AS CANDIDATE, NOT VERIFIED_ALPHA, for several reasons: (1) the round was still 'in talks' as of the reporting date, not closed; (2) no source specifies a personal check size or even confirms Luckey/Thiel/Lonsdale are putting NEW personal cash into this specific round versus simply being pre-existing founder/cap-table holders whose position is diluted or maintained -- the 'backed by' framing in headlines may just describe their founding roles, not fresh capital; (3) the money in this round appears to flow mainly through VC firm vehicles (Founders Fund, 8VC, a16z, Lux, Haun), which is the VC agent's territory, not personal capital, per this class's scope rules; (4) no clean canonical sector exists for a chartered bank -- defense-tech used as the closest fit given the client base and founder ties, but this is a real structural mismatch worth flagging. Recorded per the escalation-loop rule (a documented candidate beats a silent drop) rather than dropped, and worth revisiting once/if the round closes with a formal press release naming actual new investors and amounts. Egress to SEC EDGAR and to most direct news-site URLs (Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, Forbes, sifted.eu, etc.) was blocked in this run's network sandbox, so this entry rests on WebSearch snippets rather than full-text-verified articles.
co_investors: Founders Fund; 8VC; Andreessen Horowitz; Lux Capital; Haun Ventures (all likely/expected participants per press)
